# Aurelio Mattucci, Councilmember

![Mattucci, Aurelio - 2018(2) - Headshot](https://www.torranceca.gov/home/showpublishedimage/8068/637087767743170000)

3031 Torrance Blvd.  
Torrance, CA 90503  
Phone:   (310) 618-2801  
Fax: (310) 618-5841  
[AMattucci@TorranceCA.Gov](mailto:AMattucci@TorranceCA.Gov)

 

 

 

 

Aurelio Mattucci was first elected to the Torrance City Council on June 5, 2018. Later that month, City Council adopted an ordinance establishing by-district elections for City Council offices. He was elected to serve City Council [District 5](https://www.torranceca.gov/government/city-council-and-elected-officials/district-elections/district-5) on June 7, 2022.

He currently serves as the Chair of the Transportation Committee and is a member of the Citizen Development and Enrichment Committee and the Community Planning and Design Committee. Mattucci previously served as a member of the Strategic Plan Committee

Mattucci has a long history of community involvement. He served as Vice Chair of the Social Services Commission and as a Board Member of the Torrance Rose Float Association. He has been an active participant in the community as a Torrance Police Department Neighborhood Watch Captain, Founder of the Unified Small Business Alliance, and Vice President of the Board for New Challenge Ministries, a Torrance based food bank serving close to 2 million people in need annually.

Mattucci was born in Pescara, Italy and immigrated to the United States as a young child. He has been a Torrance resident since 1977. He and his wife Celeste share a son, Giuseppe.
